chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿUtbah al-Hāshimī, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan Mūsā عليه السلام about a man who bought something from the covering of the House: may the deceased be shrouded in it? He said: “No.”

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ مُوسَى: Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim عليه السلام, the authority being asked for the ruling
key_terms.كِسْوَةِ الْبَيْتِ: the covering of the House, meaning the cloth of the Kaʿbah

ai.seo_question: Can a deceased person be shrouded in cloth bought from the covering of the Kaʿbah?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Imam Mūsā عليه السلام concerning the use of material purchased from the covering of the Kaʿbah for a deceased person's shroud. The Imam عليه السلام forbids shrouding the dead in it, indicating a specific funerary ruling related to the sanctity and proper use of such cloth.
